why: Adamic, task aryr7ea, under rulings.md:391: tsc's own public setTextRange writes pos and end on a node after the factory made it, so Node's and NodeArray's pos and end are writable, as TextRange's are. Code that type-checked still does; a consumer may now write node.pos or array.end with no cast, where upstream's types forbid it.
